personal_info.name: Harnish Jariwala
personal_info.summary: Strategic Cloud Infrastructure Leader with 16+ years of experience specializing in Azure Architecture, FinOps, and Enterprise Governance. Proven track record of scaling high-availability systems, optimizing cloud expenditures, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver resilient, business-critical infrastructure solutions.

bullets: Standardized enterprise governance for 10+ customer environments by architecting Azure Landing Zones, enabling consistent compliance and scalable multi-tenant infrastructure.
Orchestrated HA/DR design reviews for business-critical systems, reducing Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) by 30% through automated failover mechanisms.
Mitigated high-risk failure modes in hybrid topologies by orchestrating cross-functional architecture reviews, verified by a 25% improvement in overall system reliability.
Accelerated team delivery velocity by 20% through strategic mentorship of 20 engineers on Azure best practices and efficient cloud architectural patterns.
Implemented custom Azure Policy initiatives to enforce strict compliance and security governance across diverse multi-tenant environments.
Reduced Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR) by 40% by engineering a comprehensive observability solution leveraging Azure Monitor and Grafana to proactively identify infrastructure bottlenecks.
Streamlined ITIL-based change management workflows for production by spearheading a team of 5 infrastructure engineers, improving operational efficiency and consistency.
Optimized Azure expenditure by 15% through implementing automated tagging governance and FinOps frameworks, resulting in measurable cost efficiency.
Hardened organizational identity security posture by implementing Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Conditional Access policies via Microsoft Entra ID compliance frameworks.
Increased infrastructure team capacity by 25% by spearheading internal technical hiring, onboarding, and capability-building initiatives.
Improved fault isolation across 50+ enterprise subscriptions by designing secure hub-spoke network topologies and peering, critical for enterprise-scale management.
Spearheaded critical BCDR planning, encompassing disaster recovery testing and site recovery validation, ensuring 99.9% uptime compliance for business-critical services.
Reduced maintenance-related downtime by 25% by optimizing compute lifecycle management across 500+ virtual machines through proactive, automated patching.
Isolated sensitive workloads by establishing robust network guardrails using Azure Network Security Groups (NSGs) and Application Security Groups (ASGs).
Initiated gap analysis of Azure Landing Zones against Well-Architected Framework, securing stakeholder approval for migration workstreams and reducing post-migration risk.
Validated technical roadmaps for cloud transformation, ensuring resource alignment that accelerated deployment milestones by 15%.
Engineered infrastructure lifecycle management for 2500+ VMs across 5+ Azure subscriptions.
Scaled Azure landing zones to support enterprise growth, implementing strict RBAC and policy-as-code governance.
Achieved $200k+ annual cloud cost savings (approx 20%) through systematic FinOps resource optimization.
Architected robust site recovery solutions that maintained business continuity during regional Azure outages.
Architected high-availability hybrid infrastructure, resulting in a 50% decrease in operational downtime.
Automated critical backup and disaster recovery workflows, ensuring 100% data integrity for medical workloads.
Engineered enterprise AD and DNS migration, improving identity management for 300+ users.
Optimized backup processes for onsite systems, ensuring business resilience for critical diagnostics data.
Managed full-lifecycle server deployments and technical support as a dedicated onsite engineer for a major enterprise client site, achieving a 98% service level agreement (SLA) compliance rate.
Provided onsite technical support, driving consistent 95%+ resolution rates for enterprise service requests.
